correspondences.notes: No BIDS suffix for phase quality maps.

brainlife.desc: Phase quality map (NIfTI) from phase unwrapping. Unclear: no App reads or writes it; likely a ROMEO output.
brainlife.name: neuro/phase-quality
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Masking or weighting unreliable voxels in phase-based processing such as QSM.

**Not for:** Unclear datatype with no Apps; owner review needed before use.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.phase-quality.json

identifying_risks: Unmasked whole-head maps may show the face
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level derived map; owner should confirm whether it is brain-masked.
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if the map shows recognisable facial anatomy

sources: catalog/apps/<app_id>.json (manifests of the Apps in usage)

intended_use: Masking or weighting unreliable voxels in phase-based processing such as QSM.
not_suitable_for: Unclear datatype with no Apps; owner review needed before use.
